title: I See the Moon | Kids Song, Nursery Rhymes for Toddlers | BuBu TV - English
description:
A warm and gentle English nursery rhyme about the moon, perfect for little ones aged 2-5.
Sing along with the moon, the stars, and friends who ride the sky.
A cozy bedtime song that helps children feel calm and happy.

I see the moon, and the moon sees me,
God bless the moon, and God bless me!
Moon, ride the elephant, big and grey,
Bring us mangoes, sweet and ripe today.

The moon sees somebody I wanna see,
God bless that somebody I wanna see.
Hop on the horsie, trot up the sky,
Bring some honey, bring some pie.

I see the moon, and the moon sees me,
I see the moon, and the moon sees me.

Stars are dancing, twinkle, twirl,
Baby giggles, round and whirl.
Moon, ride the peacock, shiny and bright,
Bring us candy, bring us light.

I see the moon, and the moon sees me,
I see the moon, and the moon sees me.

Bring us milk and bring us bread,
Moon, moon, tuck us into bed.
